text:
alex.martin: Heads up—DeltaHold wants a 4-week technical pilot for a chargeback/fraud assistant + agent workflows. Kickoff Tue 2pm PT. Need POC scope: success KPIs, golden prompt bank, scoring rubric, regression gates, infra/pricing options, and SQ blockers. Who volunteers to own the harness?

sana.patel: I can take the harness and build initial goldens. Please ask them for 30-50 anonymized chat+tx samples and their top 8 fraud patterns. Need expected p95/p99 and peak TPS.

eric.yu: I'll draft the scoring. Quick idea: two tracks — model label accuracy and agent-ready output quality. Metrics: Top1 accuracy, Precision@1, Explanation alignment (embedding sim), and Actionable-suggest (binary). Weighted pass >= 0.78.

kate.brooks: SQ considerations: masked PAN vs tokenized datum, retention window, access controls, customer-managed KMS? If HSM required-> adds ~3 weeks. SQ due next Fri.

secops-bot: SQ template v2 available: https://redwood/sq-templates. Post completed draft to #eng-security for review.

sana.patel: Golden prompt seeds (we'll scale to ~200):
```
G01: "User reports $2,900 ACH debit at 03:12; summarize likely fraud signals and next remediation steps."
G02: "Given tx {amt, mcc, device_age, ip_risk}: classify FRAUD/LEGIT and list top 2 reasons."
G03: "Write a 2-question agent script to verify a disputed merchant charge."
```

eric.yu: Scoring rubric (proposed): Label match (0-3), Explanation quality (0-2), Signal citation (0-2), Action clarity (0-1) = 0-8. Pass >=6. Auto-score label + explanation cosine>0.8; fallback human review for low-confidence.

alex.martin: Add regression gate: nightly golden run; fail if total weighted score drops >4% absolute OR Top1 drops >6% relative vs baseline snapshot. Human review required for any rollback.

sana.patel: Timeline (4 weeks): WK0 kickoff + data ingest; WK1 harness + seed goldens; WK2 baseline eval + prompt tuning; WK3 adversarial & regression runs; WK4 handoff + runbook.

ekic.yu: Infra note: if they want live VPC testing at 30 TPS sustained, spikes 120 TPS -> recommend Dedicated pool with autoscale (3-5 A100 equiv). Hosted offline replay cost much lower for pilot. I'll send a short cost table.

kate.brooks: Action items: - @alex.martin request 50 sample transcripts + fraud taxonomy by Mon EOD - @eric.yu share scoring skeleton by Tue - @sana.patel deliver golden seeds skeleton by Tue noon - @kate.brooks highlight SQ must-haves by Tue noon

secops-bot: Note: customer-managed KMS/HSM triggers Private path and additional compliance checks.

alex.martin: I'll send the invite and pre-kickoff checklist. Keeping thread open for updates. Thanks! :rocket:
